paper.title: No finite rulebook can certify every safe program: an impossibility theorem for gatekeeping AI agents
paper.authors_source: abs page citation_author meta tag (Perez-Acle, Tomas)
paper.code: none linked on the abs page
paper.use: METHOD ONLY: the split between what a finite record settles (an observed violation) and what it cannot (a standing never or eventually claim), and the idea of a checkable list judged against what it must admit and what it must refuse. No paper text, figures or tables are copied into this directory; this file records a location and a number token only.

quotes_note: No sentence of the abstract is quoted in this directory. The lab text copy writes the paper's doubled LaTeX quote marks around its two temporal words as HTML-escaped apostrophes, so a quotation with straight double quotes would not be word for word.

source.note: lab review copy on the shared box, not in this repo; text after the 'Abstract:' prefix, trailing newline stripped, HTML entities left as they are

not_results_of_this_sketch: Every program, universe, seed and outcome here is synthetic and deterministic. Ground truth comes from the lasso structure of each toy program; nothing here measures, reproduces or tests the paper's theorem or simulations.
